items.title: Transitivity of the universal thickening and the conormal sequence for two formally unramified morphisms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For composable formally unramified morphisms Z -> Y -> X of schemes, the lemma has two parts: the universal first order thickening of Z over Y is obtained by base-changing the thickening of Y over X along Z, and there is a canonical right exact sequence relating the conormal sheaves of the three morphisms. The first part requires comparing the two universal thickenings through their universal properties, and the second derives the sequence from the first together with the functoriality of conormal sheaves. The comparison of thickenings is the substantive step. Retained author proof at lines 1437-1455 statement, proof 1457-1490.
